elements.text: Fit the handlebar so the display faces the rider. Tighten the stem bolts to 5 Nm, alternating between them.
Fit the rear mudguard before the first ride. Use the two bolts supplied, tighten them to 4 Nm, and check that the mudguard does not touch the tyre when the wheel turns.
Exception: on the cargo version of the C-3, the rear mudguard is not requlred because the cargo rack covers the wheel. Keep the rack dra1nage holes clear.
Route both brake cables through the frame guides. Check that turning the handlebar fully does not pull on either cable.
The left pedal has a reverse thread. Turn it counterclockwise to tighten.
